# MenuBadge Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A menu bar app that mirrors the Dock badge of every app the user enables onto that app's menu bar icon (or onto MenuBadge's own item for that app), with per-app look and animation.

**Architecture:** Xcode project generated by XcodeGen. Pure logic (labels, appearance, settings, geometry, placement rules, animation curves) lives in the `BadgeKit` framework with Swift Testing unit tests. The `MenuBadge` app target holds everything that touches AppKit/AX: Dock and menu-extra readers, overlay panels, own status items, Core Animation, the engine, and a SwiftUI Settings window hosted in AppKit.

**Tech Stack:** Swift 6, Xcode 27.2, XcodeGen 2.46, AppKit + SwiftUI + QuartzCore + ApplicationServices (AX) + ServiceManagement, Swift Testing.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-13-menubadge-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Project root `~/Resources/Tool/MenuBadge` inside the hub repo `kiluss2/mac-tools`; work on branch `menubadge`.
- Bundle ids: app `com.kiluss.menubadge`, framework `com.kiluss.menubadge.BadgeKit`, tests `com.kiluss.menubadge.BadgeKitTests`.
- macOS deployment target 15.0; Swift 6 language mode.
- App signed with identity `kiluss2 Local Code Signing`, no team, Hardened Runtime off, no App Sandbox. If signing blocks loading the test bundle, sign `BadgeKit` and `BadgeKitTests` ad-hoc (`-`); only the app needs the certificate (TCC keys on it).
- `LSUIElement = YES` (no Dock icon). Installs to `~/Applications/MenuBadge.app`.
- Cost budget: polling 1 Hz (timer tolerance 0.3 s), AX messaging timeout 0.5 s, no continuous or repeating Core Animation; idle animations are one-shot animations fired from timers with random 2.5–4 s pauses.
- Defaults = today's look: corner bottom-right, size 12 pt, count colour RGBA(0.93, 0.19, 0.20, 1), dot colour RGBA(0.11, 0.60, 1.00, 1), text white, idle Blink, new-badge Shake.
- Load the `swiftui-pro` skill before writing SwiftUI and follow it.
- Commits as `kiluss2 <69423922+kiluss2@users.noreply.github.com>` (set `GIT_AUTHOR_*`/`GIT_COMMITTER_*` env vars), no Claude attribution, local commits only; push/merge only when the user says so.
- Never run the old `slack-menubar-badge` and MenuBadge at the same time on Slack except to compare deliberately (double badges); stop the old agent with `launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.kiluss2.slack-menubar-badge` before running MenuBadge, re-bootstrap it if a task ends before migration.
- Build/test commands (default DerivedData, no `-derivedDataPath`):
  - `cd ~/Resources/Tool/MenuBadge && xcodegen generate`
  - `xcodebuild test -project MenuBadge.xcodeproj -scheme BadgeKit -destination 'platform=macOS' -quiet`
  - `xcodebuild build -project MenuBadge.xcodeproj -scheme MenuBadge -configuration Debug -quiet`

## Review Focus

1. **Slack quits with default settings** → no MenuBadge "Slack" item appears; Slack relaunches → overlay is back within ~1 s. (Task 3 resolver tests, Task 5 manual check.)
2. **Corrupt or unknown-version settings data in UserDefaults** → app starts with first-launch settings (Slack on), no crash. (Task 2 store test.)
3. **Odd labels**: `"99+"`, `"New!"`, `"1234567"`, `"  "`, `"9"` → `"99+"` → readable pill, at most 4 characters, whitespace means no badge, `"9"` → `"99+"` counts as grown. (Task 1 label tests.)
4. **Accessibility revoked while running** → all badges hidden within ~1 s, Settings › General shows "Not granted", nothing hangs. (Task 6 manual check.)
5. **App icon moves or leaves the screen** (other items appear, display change, notch crowding) → overlay follows within ~1 s; an off-screen icon falls back to MenuBadge's own item. (Task 3 resolver test, Task 5 manual check.)

**Files:**

**Interfaces:**
- Produces (BadgeKit, all `public`, `Sendable`):
  - `enum BadgeLabel: Equatable, Hashable { case count(String), dot }`
  - `static func BadgeLabel.parse(_ raw: String?) -> BadgeLabel?` — trims whitespace; nil/empty → nil; `"•"`/`"●"` → `.dot`; otherwise `.count(String(trimmed.prefix(4)))`
  - `var BadgeLabel.numericValue: Int?` — leading digits as Int, +1 when followed by `"+"` (`"99+"` → 100); nil when no leading digits
  - `func isNewBadge(old: BadgeLabel?, new: BadgeLabel) -> Bool` — old nil → true; equal → false; both numeric → new > old; old `.dot` → new `.count` true; new `.dot` → false; other text change → true

### Task 3: Geometry and placement rules

**Files:**
- Create: `MenuBadge/BadgeKit/BadgeGeometry.swift`, `MenuBadge/BadgeKit/PlacementResolver.swift`
- Test: `MenuBadge/BadgeKitTests/GeometryTests.swift`, `MenuBadge/BadgeKitTests/PlacementTests.swift`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `BadgeLabel`, `Corner`, `Placement`, `OwnItemVisibility` (Tasks 1–2).
- Produces (BadgeKit, `public`):
  - `enum BadgeGeometry` with
    - `static func anchor(iconAX: CGRect, corner: Corner) -> CGPoint` — glyph assumed ~16 pt centred in the item: x = midX ± 8; y = midY − 7 (top) / midY + 6 (bottom). AX coordinates (y down).
    - `static func fontSize(for size: Double) -> Double` = `size * 0.75`
    - `static func badgeSize(label: BadgeLabel, size: Double, textWidth: Double) -> CGSize` — dot: size × size; count: width `max(size, ceil(textWidth) + size / 2)`, height size
    - `static func badgeRectAX(iconAX: CGRect, corner: Corner, badgeSize: CGSize) -> CGRect` — centred on `anchor`
    - `static func axToCocoa(_ r: CGRect, primaryScreenMaxY: Double) -> CGRect` — y = primaryScreenMaxY − r.maxY
  - `enum PlacementDecision: Equatable { case none, overlay(iconAX: CGRect), ownItem(showBadge: Bool) }`
  - `struct PlacementInput { var placement: Placement; var visibility: OwnItemVisibility; var isRunning: Bool; var iconAX: CGRect?; var iconOnScreen: Bool; var lastSeenHadOwnIcon: Bool?; var hasBadge: Bool }`
  - `func resolvePlacement(_ input: PlacementInput) -> PlacementDecision`

Rules (`resolvePlacement`):
- Not running → `.ownItem(showBadge: false)` only if `visibility == .always` and (`placement == .ownItem` or `lastSeenHadOwnIcon == false`); otherwise `.none`.
- Running, usable icon = `iconAX != nil && iconOnScreen`:
  - `.auto` / `.onAppIcon` with usable icon → `hasBadge ? .overlay(iconAX) : .none`
  - `.ownItem`, or no usable icon (any placement — never lose a badge) → `.always`: `.ownItem(showBadge: hasBadge)`; `.onlyWithBadge`: `hasBadge ? .ownItem(showBadge: true) : .none`

### Task 4: Animation curves (BadgeKit) and Core Animation + rendering (app)

**Files:**
- Create: `MenuBadge/BadgeKit/AnimationCurves.swift`
- Test: `MenuBadge/BadgeKitTests/AnimationCurveTests.swift`
- Create: `MenuBadge/MenuBadge/Badge/BadgeRenderer.swift`, `MenuBadge/MenuBadge/Badge/BadgeAnimations.swift`, `MenuBadge/MenuBadge/Badge/IdleAnimator.swift`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `BadgeLabel`, `BadgeAppearance`, `IdleAnimation`, `NewBadgeEffect`, `BadgeGeometry` (Tasks 1–3).
- Produces:
  - BadgeKit: `struct Keyframe: Equatable { var time: Double; var value: Double }`; `enum AnimationCurves { static func blink(close: Double, open: Double, double: Bool) -> [Keyframe]; static let idlePause: ClosedRange<Double> = 2.5...4; static let doubleBlinkChance = 0.25 }` — blink as in the spec (shut value 0.1, hold 0.03 s; double: second blink starts 0.1 s after the first ends, close × 0.9, open × 0.85)
  - App: `enum BadgeRenderer { static func image(_ label: BadgeLabel, _ a: BadgeAppearance) -> NSImage; static func textWidth(_ text: String, size: Double) -> Double }` (bold system font at `BadgeGeometry.fontSize`; count colour for `.count`, dot colour for `.dot`; text colour; cache keyed by label + appearance)
  - App: `enum BadgeAnimations { static func blink(_ layer: CALayer, double: Bool); static func breathe(_ layer: CALayer); static func bounce(_ layer: CALayer, height: Double); static func ripple(_ ring: CAShapeLayer); static func shake(_ layer: CALayer) }` — Blink and Shake ported unchanged from `slack-menubar-badge/main.swift` (Shake: `transform.translation.x` values `[0, -3.5, 3.5, -3, 3, -2, 2, -1, 0]`, 0.6 s, additive, easeOut). Breathe: 0.3 s, opacity 1 → 0.75 → 1 and scale 1 → 1.12 → 1, easeInEaseOut (shallow fade so the app's logo does not show through). Bounce: additive `transform.translation.y` up by `height` and back with a small second hop, ≈0.45 s (idle height 2.5 pt; new-badge height 5 pt). Ripple: ring stroked in the badge colour, scale 1 → 2.2, opacity 0.8 → 0, 0.8 s, easeOut; the badge layer itself does not move.
  - App: `@MainActor final class IdleAnimator { init(badge: CALayer, ring: CAShapeLayer); func start(_ kind: IdleAnimation); func stop() }` — one non-repeating `Timer` at a time, delay random in `idlePause`, `.none` schedules nothing; `start` with the same kind while running is a no-op.

### Task 5: AX readers, presenters, engine, demo mode

**Files:**
- Create: `MenuBadge/MenuBadge/AX/AXHelpers.swift`, `MenuBadge/MenuBadge/AX/DockBadgeReader.swift`, `MenuBadge/MenuBadge/AX/MenuExtraReader.swift`
- Create: `MenuBadge/MenuBadge/Badge/OverlayPresenter.swift`, `MenuBadge/MenuBadge/Badge/OwnItemPresenter.swift`
- Create: `MenuBadge/MenuBadge/Engine/BadgeEngine.swift`, `MenuBadge/MenuBadge/Engine/DemoScript.swift`
- Modify: `MenuBadge/MenuBadge/AppDelegate.swift` (create store + engine, start)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: everything above.
- Produces:
  - `AXHelpers`: `axAttr`, `axChildren`, `axFrame`, `appElement(pid:)` ported from `main.swift` (messaging timeout 0.5 s).
  - `@MainActor final class DockBadgeReader { func label(for bundleID: String) -> String?; func reset() }` — caches `[bundleID: AXUIElement]` from one Dock scan (tile `AXURL` → `Bundle(url:)?.bundleIdentifier`, cached per path); rescans when a requested running app has no cached tile; drops the cache entry on `.invalidUIElement`/`.cannotComplete`.
  - `@MainActor final class MenuExtraReader { func iconFrame(pid: pid_t) -> CGRect?; func reset() }` — first child of the app's `AXExtrasMenuBar`, cached per pid, re-resolved when the frame read fails or width is 0.
  - `@MainActor final class OverlayPresenter { func show(_ label: BadgeLabel, _ a: BadgeAppearance, iconAX: CGRect); func hide(); func playNew(_ effect: NewBadgeEffect) }` — panel setup ported from `Overlay` (level `statusBar + 1`, click-through, `canJoinAllSpaces | stationary | ignoresCycle`, padding so a 2.2× ripple and 5 pt bounce do not clip), badge layer `contentsScale = backing × 1.25`, `minificationFilter = .trilinear`; owns an `IdleAnimator`; re-starts it when `a.idle` changes.
  - `@MainActor final class OwnItemPresenter { init(bundleID: String); func show(_ label: BadgeLabel?, _ a: BadgeAppearance, appIcon: NSImage); func hide(); func playNew(_ effect: NewBadgeEffect) }` — `NSStatusItem` whose button image is the app icon at 16 pt; the badge is a sublayer of the button's layer, positioned with `BadgeGeometry` using the button bounds as the icon rect; click activates/opens the app.
  - `@MainActor @Observable final class BadgeEngine { private(set) var trusted: Bool; init(store: SettingsStore); func start(); func runDemo(bundleID: String) }` — 1 s timer (tolerance 0.3 s); resets readers on app launch/terminate and screen-parameter notifications; per enabled entry: running app → raw label → `BadgeLabel.parse` → icon frame → on-screen test (intersects any `NSScreen` after `axToCocoa`) → `resolvePlacement` → presenters; plays `onNew` when `isNewBadge`; writes `badgeSeen` / `lastSeenHadOwnIcon` through `store.update` (only on change); `paused` or not trusted → hide all; removes presenters of disabled/removed apps.
  - `DemoScript`: the 7 steps of `SMB_DEMO` (none 4 s, dot 8 s, 1, 3, 12, dot 8 s each, none 4 s) with English captions in a temporary status item; env `MENUBADGE_DEMO=<bundle id>` (`1` = Slack) runs it at launch then quits; `runDemo` runs it for one app without quitting.
